What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `botan`: Botan 3.14.1: doc/api_ref/hash.rst warns that Streebog's baseline implementation uses table lookups indexed by the data and is likely vulnerable to cache-based side channels; its constant-time code needs AVX-512 and GFNI, an instruction-set module that /third_party//botan's minimized build does not load.

`digests::streebog_256` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`digests::streebog_512` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
